observations: Two black power banks lying on a concrete floor.
The top power bank has a yellowish piece of paper or tape covering the front surface.
Both power banks have charging cables attached: one green braided cable and one blue braided cable.
The power banks appear to be used, with some scuffs and marks visible on the plastic casing.
No brand names, logos, or model numbers are visible on the devices.

claims.evidence: The items look used and may not hold sufficient capacity to be valuable scrap.

risks.risk: The capacity (mAh) is unknown, which is the primary factor in scrap value.
risks.proof: A photo of the manufacturer's label on the back of the power bank.
risks.if_unproven: as a low-capacity generic power bank

risks.risk: The internal battery may be degraded or dead.
risks.proof: A video showing the power bank successfully charging a device and holding a charge.

risks.risk: The cables may be damaged or have poor connectors.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the cable connectors and a video of the cables being tested.

proof_requests: Photo of the label on the back of the power banks showing the brand and capacity (mAh).
Video of the power banks charging a phone.
Close-up photos of the charging cables.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
